Synopsis:
    European equities slid to one-month lows driven by rising bond yields and escalating US-Iran tensions pushing Brent crude above $95/bbl, stoking inflation fears. Strong corporate earnings provided partial offset. ECB rate hike expectations are near-certain for next week (+25bps), with further tightening priced by year-end. German 10-year bund yields hit their highest since April 2011. Fiscal vulnerability in France, Italy, and Britain is in focus. Banking stocks bucked the trend (+0.6%), led by ING. Key movers: Lottomatica -7.7%, Cirsa +18.5%, Syensqo +3.3%, Volkswagen -3.2%.
